# Fixture media license and attribution

The media files and film subtitle adaptations in this directory are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), with the [full legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode). This notice identifies that license and the work-specific attribution; it does not replace or modify the legal code.

- **Speech sample:** IETF / OPUS Codec working group; 16-bit lossless FLAC adaptation by Commons contributor MüllerMarcus. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Speech_12dB_s16.flac), [upstream examples](https://opus-codec.org/examples/). This repository redistributes the exact source FLAC bytes without changes.
- **Sintel dialogue excerpt:** (c) copyright Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org. *Sintel* (2010), Blender Foundation and contributors. [Official distribution/license](https://durian.blender.org/sharing/). Changes: excerpt of source presentation timestamps [134 seconds, 164 seconds), H.264 video reencoding, six-channel 16-bit FLAC audio conversion and removal of metadata/chapters. English subtitle display times are shifted by exactly 134 seconds for the excerpt.

Retain attribution and indicate changes when redistributing adaptations. See `manifest.json` for exact source rendition, revision, byte hashes and reproducible adaptation command. Native tool licenses are separate and are retained by `scripts/media-tools.py` in `build/native/media/notices`.
